TEXT.English: The protected seat of a vault civilization's government. Capital Grounds replaces the Palace for the Vault Test civilization.
Required by the National Capital. This building is the foundation of the vault civilization's political authority.

The national seat of a civilization's political authority. Completing it establishes the authority identity assigned by the civilization's FoundingReligion tag, or by its leader's FavoriteReligion when no civilization assignment is provided.

Requires Capital Grounds and Currency. Establishes the civilization's political authority using its FoundingReligion identity, with the leader's FavoriteReligion as a compatibility fallback; the identity is stored through the normal religion and Holy City system.
